submitted.rationale: Of the three measurements, index 35 (Cr0.15 Fe0.52 V0.33) had the highest photocurrent: 2.89e-6 A. That is about 6x more than the V-rich/FeVO4-like index 147 and more than index 45, which has more Fe. So the photocurrent peaks near Fe ~0.5 with V ~0.3.

rejected.reason: Measured 4.5e-7 A, far below the Fe-rich region.
Measured 1.79e-6 A. Moving further toward Fe (V 0.25) lowered the merit compared with index 35.
